scope: exact E2 restricted component, not full O1; human review pending

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_OBSERVED_PROJECTION
theorems.statement: !s obs s'. assurance_observed_step s obs s' ==> x86 s s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_OBSERVED_BACKLIFT_ALL
theorems.statement: !s s'. x86 s s' ==> ?obs. assurance_observed_step s obs s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_OBSERVED_EQUIVALENCE
theorems.statement: !s s'. (?obs. assurance_observed_step s obs s') <=> x86 s s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_OBSERVED_PROGRESS
theorems.statement: !s. (?s'. x86 s s') <=> ?obs s'. assurance_observed_step s obs s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_OBSERVED_FETCH_CORRESPONDENCE
theorems.statement:
!s ip len inst es s'.
    assurance_observed_step s (ip,len,inst,es) s'
    ==> ip = read RIP s /\
        x86_decode s ip (len,inst) /\
        (?l. bytes_loaded s ip l /\ LENGTH l = len /\
             decode l = SOME(inst,[]))

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_DELTA_EXACT
theorems.statement:
!s s' d. read events s' = APPEND d (read events s)
             ==> assurance_delta s s' = d

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_OBSERVATION_EVENT_ORDER
theorems.statement:
!s s' len inst d.
    read events s' = APPEND d (read events s)
    ==> assurance_observation s len inst s' =
        (read RIP s,len,inst,REVERSE d)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_DELTA_CONCATENATION
theorems.statement:
!s0 s1 s2 d1 d2.
    read events s1 = APPEND d1 (read events s0) /\
    read events s2 = APPEND d2 (read events s1)
    ==> assurance_delta s0 s2 = APPEND d2 d1 /\
        REVERSE(assurance_delta s0 s2) =
          APPEND (REVERSE d1) (REVERSE d2)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_EVENTUALLY_CORRESPONDENCE
theorems.statement:
!P s. eventually (\a b. ?obs. assurance_observed_step a obs b) P s
           <=> eventually x86 P s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_EXECUTE_RET
theorems.statement: x86_execute RET = x86_RET

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_ACTUAL_RET_PROJECTION
theorems.statement: !len s s'. assurance_actual_ret len s s' ==> x86 s s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_ACTUAL_RET_EFFECTS
theorems.statement:
!len s s'. assurance_actual_ret len s s'
    ==> read RSP s' = word_add (read RSP s) (word 8) /\
        read RIP s' = read (memory :> bytes64 (read RSP s)) s /\
        read events s' = APPEND
          [EventJump(word_add (read RIP s) (word len),
                     read (memory :> bytes64 (read RSP s)) s);
           EventLoad(read RSP s,8)] (read events s)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_ACTUAL_RET_OBSERVATION
theorems.statement:
!len s s'. assurance_actual_ret len s s'
    ==> assurance_observation s len RET s' =
        (read RIP s,len,RET,
         [EventLoad(read RSP s,8);
          EventJump(word_add (read RIP s) (word len),
                    read (memory :> bytes64 (read RSP s)) s)])

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_DECODED_RET_ALL_SUCCESSORS
theorems.statement:
!len s. x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,RET)
    ==> !s'. x86 s s' ==> assurance_actual_ret len s s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_DECODED_RET_PROGRESS
theorems.statement:
!len s. x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,RET)
    ==> ?s'. assurance_actual_ret len s s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_SPAN_SUBRANGE
theorems.statement:
!perm a width offset count.
    assurance_span_ok perm a width /\ offset+count <= width
    ==> assurance_span_ok perm (a+offset) count

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_ZERO_STACK_EVENT_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!rp wp ip ra sp.
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(sp:int64)) 8
    ==> ALL (assurance_event_policy rp wp)
        [EventJump(ip,ra);EventLoad(sp,8)]

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_RET_EVENT_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!rp wp len s s'.
    assurance_actual_ret len s s' /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(read RSP s)) 8
    ==> ALL (assurance_event_policy rp wp)
              (assurance_delta s s')

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_STACK_ADVANCE_NONWRAP
theorems.statement:
!stackpointer:int64. val stackpointer + 8 < 2 EXP 64
    ==> val(word_add stackpointer (word 8)) = val stackpointer + 8

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_FETCH_INTERVAL_FROM_REGION
theorems.statement:
!xp codebase codesize ip len inst es.
    assurance_span_ok xp (val(codebase:int64)) codesize /\
    val codebase <= val(ip:int64) /\
    val ip+len <= val codebase+codesize
    ==> assurance_fetch_policy xp (ip,len,inst,es)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_SPAN_SELF_REGION
theorems.statement:
!rp p n. assurance_span_ok rp (val(p:int64)) n
    ==> assurance_span_ok
          (\a. rp a /\ assurance_region p n a) (val p) n

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_SPAN_MONO
theorems.statement:
!rp rp' a width.
    assurance_span_ok rp a width /\ (!x. rp x ==> rp' x)
    ==> assurance_span_ok rp' a width

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_SPAN_WORD_OFFSET_8
theorems.statement:
!rp p. assurance_span_ok rp (val(p:int64)) 16
    ==> assurance_span_ok rp (val(word_add p (word 8))) 8

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_SPAN_PREFIX
theorems.statement:
!rp a width count.
    assurance_span_ok rp a width /\ count <= width
    ==> assurance_span_ok rp a count

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_16_DATA_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!rp wp p q stackpointer ip ra.
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(p:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(q:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8
    ==> ALL (assurance_event_policy
          (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/
                        assurance_region q 16 a \/
                        assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)) wp)
        [EventJump(ip,ra);EventLoad(stackpointer,8);
         EventLoad(word_add q (word 8),8);EventLoad(q,8);
         EventLoad(word_add p (word 8),8);EventLoad(p,8)]

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_ZERO_REACHES_RET_READY
theorems.statement:
!pc sp ra p q e.
    ensures x86
      (\s. bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
           read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = sp /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 sp) s = ra /\
           C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 0] s /\ read events s = e)
      (\s. read RIP s = word(pc+93) /\ read RSP s = sp /\
           read RAX s = word 0 /\
           bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 sp) s = ra /\
           x86_decode s (read RIP s) (2,RET) /\
           read events s = APPEND
             [EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+93))] e)
      (MAYCHANGE [RIP;RAX;R10] ,, MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
       MAYCHANGE [events])

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_16_REACHES_RET_READY
theorems.statement:
!pc sp ra p q a0 a1 b0 b1 e.
    ensures x86
      (\s. bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
           read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = sp /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 sp) s = ra /\
           C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 16] s /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 p) s = a0 /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add p (word 8))) s = a1 /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 q) s = b0 /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add q (word 8))) s = b1 /\
           read events s = e)
      (\s. read RIP s = word(pc+50) /\ read RSP s = sp /\
           read RAX s = (if a0 = b0 /\ a1 = b1 then word 0 else word 1) /\
           bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
           read (memory :> bytes64 sp) s = ra /\
           x86_decode s (read RIP s) (2,RET) /\
           read events s = APPEND
             [EventLoad(word_add q (word 8),8);EventLoad(q,8);
              EventLoad(word_add p (word 8),8);EventLoad(p,8);
              EventJump(word(pc+22),word(pc+22));
              EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+16))] e)
      (MAYCHANGE [RIP;RAX;RDX;R10;R11] ,, MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
       MAYCHANGE [events])

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_RUN_PROJECT
theorems.statement:
!n P C s. assurance_checked_run n P C s
    ==> eventually_n x86 n P s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_RUN_EVENTUALLY
theorems.statement: !n P C s. assurance_checked_run n P C s ==> eventually x86 P s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_RUN_ALL_SUCCESSORS
theorems.statement:
!n P C s. assurance_checked_run (SUC n) P C s
    ==> (?s'. x86 s s') /\
        !s'. x86 s s' ==> C (SUC n) s s' /\
                           assurance_checked_run n P C s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_DECODED_OBSERVATION_ALL_SUCCESSORS
theorems.statement:
!len inst s s'.
    x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\ x86 s s'
    ==> assurance_observed_step s
          (assurance_observation s len inst s') s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_ALL_REVERSE
theorems.statement: !P (l:A list). ALL P (REVERSE l) <=> ALL P l

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_STEP_POLICY_OBSERVED
theorems.statement:
!rp wp xp s s'.
    x86 s s' /\ assurance_step_policy rp wp xp s s'
    ==> ?obs. assurance_observed_step s obs s' /\
              assurance_fetch_policy xp obs /\
              ALL (assurance_event_policy rp wp) (SND(SND(SND obs))) /\
              read events s' = APPEND (REVERSE(SND(SND(SND obs))))
                                      (read events s)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CODE_OFFSET_VALUE
theorems.statement:
!pc offset. pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 /\ offset < 95
    ==> val(word(pc+offset):int64) = pc+offset

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CODE_BASE_VALUE
theorems.statement: !pc. pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 ==> val(word pc:int64) = pc

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_RUN_STEP
theorems.statement:
!n P C s. assurance_checked_run (1+n) P C s <=>
     (?s'. x86 s s') /\
     !s'. x86 s s' ==> C (1+n) s s' /\
                        assurance_checked_run n P C s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_RET_FROM_DECODE_AND_STEP
theorems.statement:
!len s s'. x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,RET) /\ x86 s s'
    ==> assurance_actual_ret len s s'

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_ZERO_COMPLETE_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!pc stackpointer ra p q xp rp e s.
    pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok xp pc 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok
      (\a. rp a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)
      (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 0] s /\ read events s = e
    ==> assurance_checked_run 6
      (\s'. read RIP s' = ra /\
            read RSP s' = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read RAX s' = word 0 /\
            bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
            read events s' = APPEND
              [EventJump(word(pc+95),ra);EventLoad(stackpointer,8);
               EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+93))] e)
      (assurance_zero_step
        (\a. rp a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a) (\a. F) xp) s

theorems.name: ABI_SCALAR_EXTENDED_PROJECTION
theorems.statement: !s a s' a'. abi_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a') ==> x86 s s'

theorems.name: ABI_SCALAR_EXTENDED_BACKLIFT_ALL
theorems.statement: !s s' a. x86 s s' ==> abi_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a)

theorems.name: ABI_SCALAR_EXTENDED_EQUIVALENCE
theorems.statement: !s s' a. (?a'. abi_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a')) <=> x86 s s'

theorems.name: ABI_SCALAR_EXTENDED_PROGRESS
theorems.statement: !s a. (?s'. x86 s s') <=> ?s' a'. abi_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a')

theorems.name: ABI_SCALAR_STEP_PRESERVES_OMITTED
theorems.statement:
!s a s' a'. abi_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a') /\
                abi_all_decodes_scalar s ==> a' = a

theorems.name: ABI_SCALAR_EQUAL_IMPLIES_REQUIRED_CONTROLS
theorems.statement: !a a'. a' = a ==> abi_required_controls_preserved a a'

theorems.name: ABI_CRYPTO_REGISTERED_SITE_IS_SCALAR
theorems.statement: !off len inst. abi_crypto_site off len inst ==> abi_scalar_instruction inst

theorems.name: ABI_CHECKED_RUN_LIFT
theorems.statement:
!n P C s a.
    assurance_checked_run n P
      (\k source target. C k source target /\ abi_all_decodes_scalar source) s
    ==> eventually_n abi_scalar_extended_step n
          (\t. P(FST t) /\ SND t = a) (s,a)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_DECODED_SCALAR_UNIQUE
theorems.statement:
!len inst s. x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\
                abi_scalar_instruction inst
    ==> abi_all_decodes_scalar s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_ZERO_SCALAR_QUALIFIED_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!pc stackpointer ra p q xp rp e s.
    pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok xp pc 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok
      (\a. rp a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)
      (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 0] s /\ read events s = e
    ==> assurance_checked_run 6
      (\s'. read RIP s' = ra /\
            read RSP s' = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read RAX s' = word 0 /\
            bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
            read events s' = APPEND
              [EventJump(word(pc+95),ra);EventLoad(stackpointer,8);
               EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+93))] e)
      (assurance_zero_scalar_step
        (\a. rp a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a) (\a. F) xp) s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_16_STRICT_SPANS
theorems.statement:
!rp p q stackpointer.
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(p:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(q:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8
    ==> assurance_span_ok
         (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                       assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)) (val p) 8 /\
        assurance_span_ok
         (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                       assurance_region stackpointer 8 a))
         (val(word_add p (word 8))) 8 /\
        assurance_span_ok
         (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                       assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)) (val q) 8 /\
        assurance_span_ok
         (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                       assurance_region stackpointer 8 a))
         (val(word_add q (word 8))) 8 /\
        assurance_span_ok
         (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                       assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)) (val stackpointer) 8

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_16_COMPLETE_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!pc stackpointer ra p q xp rp a0 a1 b0 b1 e s.
    pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok xp pc 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(p:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(q:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 16] s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 p) s = a0 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add p (word 8))) s = a1 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 q) s = b0 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add q (word 8))) s = b1 /\
    read events s = e
    ==> assurance_checked_run 15
      (\s'. read RIP s' = ra /\
            read RSP s' = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read RAX s' = (if a0 = b0 /\ a1 = b1 then word 0 else word 1) /\
            bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
            read events s' = APPEND
              [EventJump(word(pc+52),ra);EventLoad(stackpointer,8);
               EventLoad(word_add q (word 8),8);EventLoad(q,8);
               EventLoad(word_add p (word 8),8);EventLoad(p,8);
               EventJump(word(pc+22),word(pc+22));
               EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+16))] e)
      (assurance_zero_step
        (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                      assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)) (\a. F) xp) s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_16_SCALAR_QUALIFIED_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!pc stackpointer ra p q xp rp a0 a1 b0 b1 e s.
    pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok xp pc 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(p:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(q:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 16] s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 p) s = a0 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add p (word 8))) s = a1 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 q) s = b0 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add q (word 8))) s = b1 /\
    read events s = e
    ==> assurance_checked_run 15
      (\s'. read RIP s' = ra /\
            read RSP s' = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read RAX s' = (if a0 = b0 /\ a1 = b1 then word 0 else word 1) /\
            bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
            read events s' = APPEND
              [EventJump(word(pc+52),ra);EventLoad(stackpointer,8);
               EventLoad(word_add q (word 8),8);EventLoad(q,8);
               EventLoad(word_add p (word 8),8);EventLoad(p,8);
               EventJump(word(pc+22),word(pc+22));
               EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+16))] e)
      (assurance_zero_scalar_step
        (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                      assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)) (\a. F) xp) s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_SCALAR_POLICY_RUN_LIFT
theorems.statement:
!n P rp wp xp s a.
    assurance_checked_run n P (assurance_zero_scalar_step rp wp xp) s
    ==> eventually_n abi_scalar_extended_step n
          (\t. P(FST t) /\ SND t = a) (s,a)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_SCALAR_POLICY_RUN_CONTROLS
theorems.statement:
!n P rp wp xp s a.
    assurance_checked_run n P (assurance_zero_scalar_step rp wp xp) s
    ==> eventually_n abi_scalar_extended_step n
          (\t. P(FST t) /\ abi_required_controls_preserved a (SND t)) (s,a)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_E2_PERMISSION_FUNCTIONS
theorems.statement:
(!xp ordinary pc. bp_e2_crypto_allowed_fetch xp ordinary pc =
     (\a. (xp a /\ ordinary a) /\ assurance_region (word pc) 95 a)) /\
   (!rp ordinary p q n stackpointer.
      bp_e2_crypto_allowed_read rp ordinary p q n stackpointer =
      (\a. (rp a /\ ordinary a) /\
        (assurance_region p n a \/ assurance_region q n a \/
         assurance_region stackpointer 8 a))) /\
   bp_e2_crypto_allowed_write = (\a:num. F)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_E2_FETCH_SPAN
theorems.statement:
!pc stackpointer ra p q n m rp xp ordinary s.
    bp_e2_crypto_pre pc stackpointer ra p q n m rp xp ordinary s
    ==> assurance_span_ok (bp_e2_crypto_allowed_fetch xp ordinary pc) pc 95

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_E2_READ_SPANS
theorems.statement:
!rp ordinary p q n stackpointer.
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val(p:int64)) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val(q:int64)) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8
    ==> assurance_span_ok
          (bp_e2_crypto_allowed_read rp ordinary p q n stackpointer) (val p) n /\
        assurance_span_ok
          (bp_e2_crypto_allowed_read rp ordinary p q n stackpointer) (val q) n /\
        assurance_span_ok
          (bp_e2_crypto_allowed_read rp ordinary p q n stackpointer)
          (val stackpointer) 8

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_E2_ZERO_ALLOWED_READ
theorems.statement:
!rp ordinary p q stackpointer.
    bp_e2_crypto_allowed_read rp ordinary p q 0 stackpointer =
      (\a. (rp a /\ ordinary a) /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_E2_POLICY_PRODUCT
theorems.statement:
!n P rp wp xp s a.
    assurance_checked_run n P (assurance_zero_scalar_step rp wp xp) s
    ==> eventually_n abi_scalar_extended_step n
          (\t. P(FST t) /\ SND t = a /\
               abi_required_controls_preserved a (SND t)) (s,a)

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_E2_CHECKED_RUN_MONO
theorems.statement:
!n P Q C s. (!t. P t ==> Q t) /\ assurance_checked_run n P C s
    ==> assurance_checked_run n Q C s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_ZERO_FRAMED_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!pc stackpointer ra p q xp rp e m s.
    pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok xp pc 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok
      (\a. rp a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)
      (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 0] s /\ read events s = e /\ read memory s = m
    ==> assurance_checked_run 6
      (\s'. read RIP s' = ra /\
            read RSP s' = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read RAX s' = word 0 /\
            bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
            read events s' = APPEND
              [EventJump(word(pc+95),ra);EventLoad(stackpointer,8);
               EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+93))] e /\ read memory s' = m /\
            (MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11] ,,
             MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,, MAYCHANGE [events]) s s')
      (assurance_zero_scalar_step
        (\a. rp a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a) (\a. F) xp) s

theorems.name: ASSURANCE_CRYPTO_16_FRAMED_POLICY
theorems.statement:
!pc stackpointer ra p q xp rp a0 a1 b0 b1 e m s.
    pc+95 <= 2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok xp pc 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(p:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(q:int64)) 16 /\
    assurance_span_ok rp (val(stackpointer:int64)) 8 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\ read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word 16] s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 p) s = a0 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add p (word 8))) s = a1 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 q) s = b0 /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_add q (word 8))) s = b1 /\
    read events s = e /\ read memory s = m
    ==> assurance_checked_run 15
      (\s'. read RIP s' = ra /\
            read RSP s' = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
            read RAX s' = (if a0 = b0 /\ a1 = b1 then word 0 else word 1) /\
            bytes_loaded s' (word pc) crypto_memcmp_mc /\
            read events s' = APPEND
              [EventJump(word(pc+52),ra);EventLoad(stackpointer,8);
               EventLoad(word_add q (word 8),8);EventLoad(q,8);
               EventLoad(word_add p (word 8),8);EventLoad(p,8);
               EventJump(word(pc+22),word(pc+22));
               EventJump(word(pc+16),word(pc+16))] e /\ read memory s' = m /\
            (MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11] ,,
             MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,, MAYCHANGE [events]) s s')
      (assurance_zero_scalar_step
        (\a. rp a /\ (assurance_region p 16 a \/ assurance_region q 16 a \/
                      assurance_region stackpointer 8 a)) (\a. F) xp) s
